# Harsh Patel
> Personal site of Harsh Patel, a senior software engineer at PagePilot AI and the builder of AltMaster, a free Shopify app. He writes interactive explainers and engineering case studies about Shopify apps and APIs.

## About
- Senior Software Engineer at PagePilot AI (https://pagepilot.ai/)
- Built AltMaster, a free Shopify app that writes alt text for product images: https://apps.shopify.com/alt-text-optimizer (site: https://altmaster.io/)
- Based in India

## Writing
- Shopify's GraphQL rate limit is a leaky bucket: https://harshspatel.com/writing/shopify-graphql-rate-limits/
- All writing: https://harshspatel.com/writing/
